cases.text:
claim SimpleSubstanceComposition:
  given compound >= simple substance
  given simple substance >= element
  infer compound >= element
  source: Monadology §§1-3
  status: derived

claim NoExternalWindow:
  given simple substance >= no external alteration
  infer simple substance >= no external window
  source: Monadology §7
  status: open

claim PerceptionAppetition:
  given perception >= internal variety
  given appetition >= perception
  infer appetition >= internal variety
  source: Monadology §§14-15
  status: derived

claim PresentFuture:
  given present state >= preceding state
  given future state >= present state
  infer future state >= preceding state
  source: Monadology §22
  status: derived

claim ReasonAndSufficiency:
  given contradiction >= false
  infer sufficient reason >= true
  source: Monadology §§31-32
  status: open

claim DistinctMonads:
  given monad A >= monad B
  infer monad B >= monad A
  source: Monadology §9
  status: open

claim SufficientReasonChain:
  given reason >= contingent fact
  given sufficient reason >= reason
  infer sufficient reason >= contingent fact
  source: Principles of Nature and Grace §7
  status: derived

claim FalseBridge:
  given a >= b
  infer a >= c
  source: benchmark control
  status: open
